items.description: India's captain Shubman Gill won the toss and chose to bowl first against New Zealand in Wellington. items.title: Goldman Sachs upgrades India to overweight, sees Nifty at 28,500
items.description: Goldman Sachs has upgraded India's investment outlook to overweight, targeting a Nifty level of 28,500 by the end of 2027. The brokerage cites expected earnings growth recovery and resilient domestic demand as key factors. It notes that foreign investor positioning is at a decade-low, presenting India as an attractive opportunity. Additionally, recent foreign flows into Indian equities suggest a recovery trend.

items.title: Goldman Sachs sees rupee stabilising around 94 over next quarter

items.description: A Texas appellate court has confirmed a lower court's decision regarding the divorce property division between Julian and Alice Devon Poole. However, the court found he failed to substantiate his claims adequately, leading to a ruling that mandates an equal division of marital assets between the spouses, thus upholding the trial court's verdict.
